Commentary.Commentary: Right then, that is all we have from this second ODI. South Africa have levelled the series with a comprehensive win in this encounter and we will now be moving to the SuperSport Park, Centurion for the decider. That game will be played on Wednesday, 23rd March. It is a day-night fixture and it will start at 4.30 pm IST (11.00 am GMT). As you know, our coverage will start well in advance. So do join us for the same. Till then, goodbye and cheers!

Temba Bavuma, the South African skipper, says that his finger is bit sore and it will be clearer after the scan. He adds that that resilience is a big thing for them. He mentions that they need to begin the series well though. Tells that bowlers bowled well at the upfront and that gave them momentum. He applauds Quinton de Kock and says that he played quite well. Tells that Centurion will be a much truer pitch to bat on and they will take confidence from this game forward.

Kagiso Rabada is the PLAYER OF THE MATCH. He says that he is happy with the win today and also with his performance. He mentions that the pitch was a different one from that of the last match and they got purchase early on which helped him get the wickets in the Powerplay. The pitch afterwards though got better for batting and their bowlers had to use their variations. He also adds that you have to try and keep it simple and not be too aggressive as that can back fiore and hence he stayed away from the short ball today.

Tamim Iqbal, the Bangladesh skipper, says that the wicket was uneven and it was a bit difficult. Adds that they bowled well but still made some mistakes. Mentions that given the wicket 100 would have been difficult but 194 could have been defended. Lastly mentions that they cannot take this game lightly and need to improve for the final game.
Time for the presentation.

Quinton de Kock then, set the stage on fire with a classy knock. His half-century with a strike-rate of over 150 meant that South Africa were never really put under pressure in the run-chase. Bangladesh did managed to get rid of both openers eventually, but a matured stand between Bavuma and Verreynne made sure that South Africa go about their business in a clinical fashion. Overall a dominating performance by the hosts and two of their biggest stars, Rabada and Quniton De Kock played a major role in this thumping win.

The tone of this comfortable South African victory, was set in the early overs with the new ball by their bowlers as they grabbed five Bangladeshi wickets in quick time. Bangladesh were always behind the 8-ball after that and even though they got to a respectable total in the end, due to some handy knocks from Afif Hossain and Mehidy Hasan, South Africa were always favourites to win this game coming into the second-half.

South Africa is a proud cricketing nation and they have made a strong statement here with a clinical performance in a do-or-die game. They level the series now and more importantly have got those crucial World Cup Super League points, they desperately needed from this game. Bangladesh, on the other hand, will be disappointed with this performance and they would eye a better show in the decider now.

FOUR! That's it! Rassie van der Dussen has finished things off in style and South Africa have made it 1-1! This is short and wide, Rassie hangs back and slaps it through covers for a boundary. The hosts win comfortably by 7 wickets!
This is pushed well outside off. Kyle Verreynne looks to drive but gets an inside edge past the off stump and picks up a single.
On middle, pushed down the ground for one.
Shorter but slower. Verreynne makes room to cut but edges it back onto the deck.
On the pads, turned through square leg for one more.
Short and wide, slapped away to cover. The fielder over there fumbles and allows the single.
Afif slides one across the off stump and this one keeps low. Verreynne looks to cut but misses.
On middle and leg, flicked towards mid-wicket.
On the pads, eased through wide mid on for a single.
On the pads, swept away to deep backward square leg for one more. Single digits required now for South Africa.
Sliding onto off, pushed off the inner half of the bat back to the bowler.
On off, defended out by van der Dussen.
On middle and leg, pushed away off the back foot to deep mid-wicket for one.
Shorter and on middle. Verreynne makes room and punches it towards extra cover.
Mahmudullah is brought into the attack now.
Quicker one, on middle and leg. Rassie van der Dussen gets pushed onto the back foot but keeps it out. South Africa just playing out the overs now and not looking to end the match with a flourish.
Down the leg side, this is tickled down to fine leg for one more.
On leg stump, flicked straight to the man at short mid-wicket.
Drifted onto the pads, this is wristed away through square leg for a single.
On off, Verreynne reaches out and pushes it towards mid off for a quick single.
Around leg stump, this is tucked away to square leg.
On middle and turning away. Rassie van der Dussen watchfully blocks it out. Shakib Al Hasan ends his spell with another maiden.
Flatter one, on off. Rassie van der Dussen edges it down towards point.
A bit slower and around middle. Blocked.
Around off, Rassie van der Dussen keeps it out on the off side.
Fuller again, driven straight to the man at cover by Rassie.
Quicker and fuller, on off. This is pushed away towards cover.
Flatter one, around off. Verreynne cuts it hard but straight towards cover. Just 14 more required now.
Shorter and quicker, on off. Punched away off the back foot towards covers.

FOUR! Gets this one through does Kyle Verreynne and brings up his fifty as well. A very well-compiled innings from him today. Shorter and outside off. Verreynne stands tall and thumps it through covers for a boundary.
Around middle and leg, nudged off the inner half of the bat towards short fine leg.
Rassie is off the mark straightaway. On the pads, tucked away off the back foot to deep mid-wicket for one.
Rassie van der Dussen is the next man in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Temba Bavuma was looking a bit edgy out there and eventually ends up giving away his wicket. On the pads, Bavuma gets down on one knee and sweeps it away. He plays it aerially but doesn't have enough timing on it to clear the fence. Shoriful Islam takes a fine catch at the backward square leg fence and Afif Hossain has a wicket. He's had a brilliant game but it's just a consolation wicket in the end.
Commentary.Howout: c Shoriful Islam b Afif Hossain

Commentary.Commentary: Full and straight, driven down to long off for one.
Around off, a slight shuffle from Bavuma but blocks it out in the end.
On off, nudged away towards cover.
Nicely drifted into middle and leg. Temba Bavuma watchfully keeps it out.
On off, stroked away to long off for a single.
Shorter and on off. Verreynne looks to cut but gets it off the bottom edge towards the bowler.
And again! Around leg, Bavuma sweeps and makes no connection. Just one run off the last 2 overs. 21 needed now off 19 overs.
Tossed up, around leg. Bavuma goes for the hard sweep behind square but misses and gets hit on the pads.
On middle, turned through mid-wicket for a run.
This is slid across off, Verreynne taps it onto the off side.
Fuller and around middle. Pushed back to the bowler.
On leg stump and turning into the pads. Verreynne hangs back and tucks it away towards square leg.
Flatter this time, again on off and Bavuma defends it towards covers. Maiden!
Around off, stroked away towards cover.
Quicker one, on off. Blocked out.
Tossed up, on off. Bavuma drives but can't beat the fielder at cover-point.
On middle, flicked away leg side.
It's the arm ball! This one slides into off. Bavuma keeps it out.

NOT OUT! Afif Hossain slides this one across off. Kyle Verreynne doesn't pick up the length and reaches out to drive. He misses and the bails are take off by the keeper. The umpires go upstairs. The catch is checked first but there's a flat line on UltraEdge. The replays show that Verreynne never had his foot out of the crease and he survives.
Is this stumped? The replays roll in and they show that Kyle Verreynne's back foot is grounded and he will continue.
Around leg, this is eased down to long on for a run.

Temba Bavuma getting a bit too excited now. Tossed up on middle and turning in. Bavuma dances down the track and looks to hit it out of  the ground over the mid-wicket fence but gets no contact on it.
Verreynne steps out and Afif pushes it a bit wider. Verreynne manages to steer it through wide mid on for a single.
On off, dipping on the batter. Verreynne keeps it out.
Floated up, across the off stump. Bavuma shuffles and works it through square leg for a single.
On off, nudged towards extra cover for an easy single.
FOUR! Picked up and dispatched! This is dragged down on middle and leg. Bavuma rocks back and lifts it over mid-wicket and picks up a boundary.
Around off, stroked to deep cover for one more by Verreynne.
On leg stump, eased towards mid on.
Around off, Temba Bavuma goes for the reverse sweep but gets it off the gloves towards short third man. They do go for the risky single and get it.
Slowed up, on a length and on off. Verreynne waits for it and taps it through covers for a single.
Around off, dabbed down towards cover-point. Ths hosts need 33 more runs now.
Edged and four! Mustafizur Rahman goes seam up this time and bowls it outside off. Temba Bavuma goes hard at it and gets a thick outside edge that runs down to the third man fence.
A slower short ball, around off. Bavuma awkwardly keeps it down towards backward point.

Slower again, this time bowled into the pitch and Bavuma taps it towards point. There's a direct-hit at the keeper's end but Temba Bavuma has hi bat inside the crease. The umpire doesn't take it upstairs and rightly so.
Nicely bowled! Slower ball, pushed well outside off. Bavuma looks to cut but gets completely undone by the lack of pace and the lack of bounce as well.
WIDE! Mustafizur Rahman comes over the wicket and spills it down the leg side. Bavuma looks to whip it off his hips but misses. Wided.
Pitched up, on off. Bavuma drives it without much timing and towards mid off.

FOUR! Floated up, a bit outside off. Kyle Verreynne cover drives through the line and gets it through covers. The man running in from the point fence can't cut it off. Boundary. In touching distance now South Africa.
Nicely flighted, on off. Verreynne nudges it towards short cover.
Sliding into the pads, Verreynne flicks it leg side but can't fine the gap.
On off, blocked.
Flatter, on off. Verreynne hangs back and cuts it really late, past short third man for a couple.
Sliding into middle, pushed onto the off side.
Pushed quicker on middle. Bavuma defends it out. Just 44 runs needed from 150 balls!
WIDE! This one pitches on leg and turns further down the leg side. Bavuma looks to clip it but misses.
Flatter around leg again. Bavuma works it towards the leg side.
Quicker and flatter on middle. Bavuma works it towards short mid-wicket.
Fuller on middle. Bavuma flicks it through mid-wicket for a couple.

FOUR! Ohh...now a misfield from Shoriful Islam and Bavuma gets a boundary! On middle. Bavuma sweeps it towards the backward square leg region. Islam runs to his left and dives to stop it but the ball goes through him for a boundary.
On off and turning into the batter. Kyle Verreynne works it behind square on the off side for a single. 50 partnership comes up!
Goes fuller on off. Kyle Verreynne pushes it to long off for a single.
On the shorter side on off. Bavuma punches it to mid on for a single.
Darted on middle and leg. Bavuma looks to work it towards the leg side but misses.
Pushed quicker on middle. Bavuma pushes it to mid on.
On off and full again. Kyle Verreynne drives it to long off for a single.
Fuller on middle. Kyle Verreynne drives it to short cover.
Fuller on middle and leg. Bavuma works it to deep mid-wicket for a couple.
Slightly shorter on middle and keeps it a tad low. Kyle Verreynne goes deep in his crease and works it away watchfully towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
On off and fuller. Bavuma paddle-sweeps it towards the fine leg region for a single.
On middle and flatter. Bavuma works it towards mid-wicket.
Goes fuller, outside off. Bavuma drives it to covers.
Slower in the air, on middle. Bavuma works it towards square leg.
SIX! This time a flat bullet! Taskin Ahmed contnues with his short stuff. Goes short on off. Kyle Verreynne hangs on the back foot and slams it flat over deep square leg fence for a maximum.

SIX! South Africa are in mood to finish this off quickly! Another short ball and punished again. Taskin Ahmed is not learning, he bangs this short on off. Kyle Verreynne is expecting it and pulls it over deep square leg for a biggie.
Goes fuller on off at 141 kph. Kyle Verreynne drives it to short cover.
FOUR! Good shot! Taskin Ahmed has been expensive today! On the shorter side on off, at a comfortable height. Kyle Verreynne pulls it towards deep mid-wicket for a boundary.
On a length, around off. Kyle Verreynne drives it on up towards covers.
On a good length, on off at 132 kph. Kyle Verreynne pushes it to mid off.
Slower in the air, fuller on off. Bavuma blocks it off the front foot.
Shorter in length, on off and turning away again. Bavuma looks to pull but misses.
Bit of bounce and turn! On off and it turns away with bounce. Bavuma gets the top of his blade as he looks to defend and the ball goes towards point.
Nicely played! On off. Bavuma paadle-sweeps it towards long leg for a couple.
Shorter around off. Kyle Verreynne goes back and cuts it to sweeper cover for a single.
Shakib Al Hasan serves this fuller on off. Bavuma drives it back to the bowler. Shakib Al Hasan fumbles a bit and a run is taken.
This is pitched up on off. Verreynne gets pushed back into the crease but blocks it out.
On a good length, angled into off. Bavuma plays it on the up and through covers for a single.
A length ball, nipping back in from off stump. Bavuma stays solid in defense.
SIX! This is a shot of authority from the skipper! Banged in halfway. Temba Bavuma stands tall and pulls it nonchalantly over the mid-wicket fence for a biggie.

This is pushed wider and banged into the deck. Temba Bavuma goes after it but gets beaten due to the steep bounce. There's an appeal from the bowler and the keeper but Bangladesh have no more reviews remaining.
A bit of width on offer, Verreynne strokes it to the man at sweeper cover and picks up a single.
On the pads, turned through mid-wicket for a single this time. South Africa smartly playing out the Bangladeshi spinners.
This is darted into middle. Verreynne manages to keep it down towards a catching mid-wicket.
Fuller and on off, worked off the leading edge towards covers for another single.
One more. Shorter and on middle. Verreynne half-pulls it to long on.
On middle, this is eased down to long on for a single.
Really slow, on off. This one turns in a long way. Bavuma waits for it and tucks it onto the leg side.
A tad shorter, around off. Verreynne taps it towards cover-point.
On off, driven straight to the man at cover.
Slowed up, on a length and around off. The ball turns away a bit and Verreynne blocks it off the back foot.
Quicker one, on off. This is cut away late, through short third man for a couple of runs.
Floated up, sliding on with the arm and into leg stump. Verreynne works it onto the leg side.
Sliding down leg, nicely tucked 'round the corner for a single by Bavuma.
Nicely flighted, around middle. Verreynne nudges it towards short mid-wicket.
On middle, this is pushed towards mid on.
Quicker one, on off. Verreynne keeps it out on the off side.
Tossed up, on middle and there's plenty turn again. Bavuma flicks it off the inner half of the bat towards backward square leg for a run.
On middle and turning in, nudged past short leg for a single. The 100 is up for South Africa.
On off, this one turns and bounces as well. Verreynne does well to dab it down on the leg side.
On middle, pushed towards mid-wicket for a quick single.
Quicker one, darted into middle and leg. Verreynne does well to make room and push it out on the off side.
This one slides on with the arm. Around off, Verreynne keeps it out.
FOUR! Floated up, on leg stump. Kyle Verreynne just pushes it through the gap between mid on and mid-wicket and picks up a boundary.

Drinks! So the wicket of Quinton de Kock just at the stroke of drinks have brought Bangladesh back in this game. South Africa are sill in a comfortable position but Bangladesh have an opening now and they need to bowl better, to put more pressure on South Africa. Temba Bavuma walks out to the middle and his partnership with Kyle Verreynne will be key now. A decent partnership between these two here and Bangladesh will be knocked out of this game.

OUT! TAKEN! What a catch that is from Afif Hossain! Tossed up, on off. Quinton de Kock gets down on one knee and goes for the slog sweep. He hits it towards the long boundary and it seems to be just sailing over the fielder. Hossain picks it up nicely, pouches it and he has the presence of mind to push it back up in the air as he is going over the boundary. He comes back in and takes it safely, astonishing! Quinton de Kock has to walk back after a fiery knock but Shakib Al Hasan has provided the breakthrough Bangladesh needed. 100 required now off about 35 more overs.
Commentary.Howout: c Afif Hossain b Shakib Al Hasan

Commentary.Commentary: Is this a fair catch? The replays show that Afif Hossain has done a brilliant job in the deep and is inside the ropes when he completes the catch.
Flatter one, around off. De Kock pushes it towards short mid on.
Six singles in the over! Outside off and keeps a bit low. Quinton de Kock pushes it to long on for a single.
He needs to be fuller, this is slightly short on off. Kyle Verreynne goes back and knocks it down to long on for an easy single.
On the shorter side again, outside off. Quinton de Kock cuts it to sweeper cover for a single.
Turn again, it pitches on off and turns into middle. Kyle Verreynne goes back and pushes it to long on for a single.
Slower in the air, on off and fuller. Quinton de Kock drives it to sweeper cover for a single.
Shorter and turning down the leg side. Kyle Verreynne pulls it to fine leg for a single.
Darted on middle and leg. Kyle Verreynne works it to fine leg for a single.
A flatter delivery on middle. Kyle Verreynne goes deep in his crease and blocks it.
Nicely bowled, loopy delivery, outside off. Kyle Verreynne reaches for it and gets a thick outside edge to point.
Slower in the air, on off. Kyle Verreynne pushes it to covers again.
Slower in the air, on off. Kyle Verreynne drives it towards short cover. Well-fielded there.
Slightly shorter and flatter on middle. Quinton de Kock works it to square leg for a single.
Leading edge! Slower in the air, on middle. Kyle Verreynne looks to work it towards the leg side. The ball catches the leading edge of his blade as he plays it tad early. Good over by Mehidy Hasan.
A flatter delivery on middle. Kyle Verreynne defends it towards the leg side.
Slower in the air, on middle. Kyle Verreynne skips down the track and fails to reach the pitch of the ball. He works it uppishly towards short mid-wicket but luckily for him, it falls just short.
Kyle Verreynne walks in at number 3.

OUT! BOWLED! Mehidy Hasan provides the first breakthrough! Malan departs and have to say, this is a poor shot selection from him. A fuller delivery pitching around off and turning into middle. Malan gets across and looks to sweep it but misses as the ball turns into him. It shatters the stumps and Malan has to walk back now. Can Bangladesh get back into this game now?
On middle and flatter. Malan goes back and blocks it.
FOUR! Nicely played! On middle and turning into leg. Malan goes deep in his crease and works it  through square leg for a boundary.
A length delivery and slower in pace outside off. Quinton de Kock goes for a big mighty swing across the line but misses.
WIDE! Full and down the leg side. Quinton de Kock looks to flick it but misses.
Serves a length ball, on off. Quinton de Kock mistimes his drive to mid on.
FOUR! Supreme timing yet again! Rahman lands it on a length, around off. Quinton de Kock just creams it past point for a boundary.
Back of a length, around off. Malan steps out and steers it through point for a single.
On a length, around off and a bit of extra bounce. Malan defends it as the ball hits him high on the bat.
Goes fuller on off. Malan drives it to mid off.

Ohh...dropped by Rahim! Costly miss this! On off and turning away from the batter. Quinton de Kock looks to drive it away but gets a thick outside edge. Rahim behind the stumps fails to grab it and the batters run couple behind square on the off side.
Goes fuller on middle. Malan pushes it to long on for a single.
A flatter delivery on middle. Malan works it towards the leg side.

It seems close and Tamim Iqbal has gone for the review. Understandably so as Bangladesh desperately need a wicket. There is no knick on UltraEdge and Ball Tracker shows it as umpire's call on the impact. Janneman Malan had started walking off but the umpires have called him back.

NOT OUT! Tossed up around off. Malan looks to for a big slog-sweep but misses. The ball hits his back leg. There is a huge appeal from Mehidy Hasan but the umpire is not interested. Bangladesh decide to take review. The replays roll in and the UltraEdge shows no bat involved. The Ball Tracker rolls and it shows that the impact is outside off. So Malan will continue.
Slightly shorter on middle. Quinton de Kock pushes it to long on for a single.
Slower in the air, on middle. Quinton de Kock makes a bit of room but ends up defending it towards the off side.
Powerplay 2 time. A maximum of 4 fielders are now allowed outside the ring till the 40th over.

A dot to end the first over from Mustafizur Rahman. This is angled into middle and leg, pushed towards mid on. At the end of the Powerplay, South Africa are 72/0! They now need 123 runs from 40 overs.
Nicely bowled! A slower from Mustafizur Rahman on off stump. Malan manages to jam it out.
On off, steered down towards third man for a single.
Short ball, outside off and this one zips through. Quinton de Kock looks to whack it over the point fence but gets undone by the steep bounce.
This is pushed through on leg stump. Malan jabs it towards wide mid on for a quick single.
This is pitched up on middle and leg. Malan stays solid in defense.
Mustafizur Rahman is into the attack now, can he stop this onslaught from Quinton de Kock?
Quicker one, on off. De Kock cuts it towards cover-point.
On the pads, flicked away to mid-wicket for a single by Malan.
On middle, turned onto the leg side.
Shorter, on off. De Kock works it towards wide mid on for a single and that will be his fifty. What a blistering knock this has been!
FOUR! Quinton de Kock is in T10 mode, not even T20 mode! Tossed up, on off. This is whacked over mid on for another boundary. Moves to 49 now does de Kock.
FOUR! Quinton de Kock is unstoppable at the moment! Floated up, around off. De Kock shuffles a bit and sweeps it into the gap again, through square leg and collects another boundary.
Pitched and angling across off. Malan bunts it out towards point.
Around off, dabbed down on the off side for an easy single.
FOUR! Make that three in a row! Full and wide, smokes over the cover fielder for yet another boundary. He's raced into the 40s.
FOUR! Quinton de Kock in full flow. Good-length but there's width on offer. De Kock stands tall and thumps it through cover-point for a boundary.
FOUR! This is short and on the body. De Kock pulls it aerially towards the vacant square leg fence and picks up another boundary. 50 up for the hosts in no time!
Back of a length, outside off. Quinton de Kock hangs back and slaps it straight to the man at point. De Kock will feel he missed out on that one.
Around off, pushed down to long off for a single.

Around off and turning away, de Kock looks for the reverse again but misses. The ball hits the pads and goes towards first slip. Shout from the bowler and the keeper but it's hitting outside the line of off stump.
Flatter one, on off. Blocked out by de Kock.
SIX! Carnage! Tossed up, around off. Quinton de Kock skips down the track, hits it inside out over extra cover and the ball flies well over the fence. Classy shot!
FOUR! This time the conventional sweep and de Kock gets it away. Down the leg side, swept away behind square on the leg side for a boundary.
The reverse sweep is out! Sliding onto middle and leg, de Kock sweeps it straight towards point.
Around the top of off, Malan keeps it down towards point.
Full toss, on the pads. This is flicked away towards fine leg for a brace. Good running!
Angled across on off stump. Malan blocks it out.
FOUR! As easy as you like! Fullish ball, outside off. This is driven on the up through point and the ball races along the ground to the fence.
On off, punched towards extra cover.
Beaten! On a length, in that channel around off. There's steep bounce on offer and the ball nips back in a bit as well. Malan looks to drive on the up but is comprehensively beatem.
Around off, pushed onto the off side off the front foot.
Really good fielding! Tossed up, on off. Quinton de Kock goes inside out over extra cover but Mahmudullah does well to race across from long off and cut it out. Two taken.
On off, turning in a fair bit. Malan plays it nicely towards mid-wicket and scampers through for one.
Just a hint of turn there. On middle and turning in. Malan looks to flick it leg side but gets a leading edge onto the off side.
This one slides onto middle, Malan blocks it back to the bowler.
Floated, on a length and around off. Malan defends it towards short cover.
Early bowling change from the Bangladesh skipper. Time for some spin. Mehidy Hasan is into the attack.
FOUR! Quinton de Kock looks in excellent touch now. Full and straight, drilled hard and low, right back past the bowler for another boundary. 14 off the over and South Africa are off to a flier.
Taskin comes 'round the wicket now, hurls across a length ball on off. De Kock hangs back and defends it out.

SIX! Wow! Pitched up, around off. Quinton de Kock picks up the length early, just shuffles across and smokes it all the way over the long on fence for a biggie. Tamim Iqbal has to get into the stands and pick up the ball as the crowd is not allowed to touch the ball due to covid protocols. Some extra work here for the Bangladeshi skipper.
FOUR! First boundary of the day for de Kock! On a good length, outside off. De Kock stands tall and just punches it sweetly through point for a glorious boundary.
Length, around leg. De Kock walks towards the ball but can't get it past the fielder at mid-wicket.
Pitched up, on off. De Kock with a solid front foot defensive shot towards short cover.
Nicely bowled! Slightly fuller, closer to the off pole and sliding across the batter. The ball holds its line at the last moment and Malan is beaten past the outside edge.
On the top of middle, Malan covers the line of the ball and punches it back to the bowler.
Length this time on middle. Malan blocks it out.
FOUR! Up and over! Banged in short on middle. Janneman Malan rides the bounce and pulls it aerially to the left of deep backward square leg fence to make it back-to-back boundaries.
FOUR! A bit of width on offer and Janneman Malan takes full advanatge. Malan shimmies down the track a bit and drives it on the up through cover-point for the first boundary of the innings.
Around off, pushed away towards covers by Malan.
On a good length, on off and this one nips back in late. De Kock looks to flick but gets hit on the gloves and he is in some pain.
Fullish ball on middle, Malan clips it through square leg for a single.
Around the top of off. Malan defends it under the eye line.
Quinton de Kock is away! Good-length, on off. De Kock drops it on the off side and scampers through for a single.

NOT OUT! A length ball, pitching around leg stump. Quinton de Kock looks to flick it away leg side but misses and gets rapped on the pads. Taskin Ahmed is certain it's out and eventually Tamim Iqbal reviews. UltraEdge shows that there's no bat involved and Ball Tracker confirms that it is pitching outside leg. The onfield decision stands and de Kock escapes. Bangladesh though will feel they are in the game with the extra bounce.

In the air...safe! Taskin Ahmed bangs it in hard on off stump. The ball just pops off the surface and Quinton de Kock is caught off guard. The ball goes off the splice of the bat but lands safely around the cover region.
WIDE! Ahmed starts off with a wayward delivery, wide of off stump. Wide signalled.
Who will bowl from the other end? It's going to be Taskin Ahmed.
He goes fuller on middle. Malan drives it to mid on. So just two runs from the first over and a decent start from Shoriful Islam.
On a good length and angling across the batter. Malan defends it towards the off side solidly.
Goes fuller this time, on off. Malan drives it to covers.
Back of a length, around off. Malan dabs it towards point.
Lands it on a length, around off. Malan defends it towards point.
A fullish delivery on off to start. Malan leans forward and he drives it through covers for a couple of runs. Janneman Malan and South Africa are underway!
